subject.title: [Bug] ACP sessions_spawn with opencode agentId: session registered but 0 bytes transcript (silent failure)

question: Should ACP preserve completed no-event turns as a supported backend contract, or should visible spawned-agent sessions require at least one assistant/tool event or a typed no-dispatch error?
rationale: The assigned ACP review identifies valid empty-event completion as an existing acpx contract, so deciding whether visible OpenClaw sessions narrow that contract requires maintainer intent after a live OpenCode bind separates configuration failure from a generic runtime invariant.

options.title: Preserve backend contract, diagnose invalid dispatch
options.body: Recommended: retain valid acpx empty completions but add a typed error only when the live bind proves the selected OpenCode agent never launched or dispatched.

options.title: Require visible-session events
options.body: Define visible ACP sessions as successful only after assistant or tool activity, accepting compatibility work for backends that currently complete without events.

recommendation.title: Preserve backend contract, diagnose invalid dispatch
recommendation.body: Recommended: retain valid acpx empty completions but add a typed error only when the live bind proves the selected OpenCode agent never launched or dispatched.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and have already identified the acpx compatibility boundary that this product decision changes.
